purpose: Author-hosted FiveM audio releases with written setup notes.

items.name: Feji’s Realistic Sound Pack
items.author: Feji
items.description: Local weapon audio replacements for players who want a different sound mix on their own client.
requirements: Follow the author’s written instructions for the GTA V installation you use with FiveM. The release calls for replacing two archives in x64/audio/sfx.
Back up both originals and check that the server allows client audio replacements. The release does not establish Enhanced compatibility.

items.name: Weapon Sound Pack
items.author: hercet
items.description: Weapon audio that plays locally for the player who installs it.
requirements: Use the author’s FiveM release and identify the original archives in your GTA V x64/audio/sfx folder before changing files.
Check the server’s rules for client audio and keep the original files so you can restore them.

items.name: Custom Vehicle Engine Sounds
items.author: Aquaphobic
items.description: A set of engine and exhaust sounds that server operators can assign to individual vehicles.
items.requirementLabel: Server resource · Choose the FiveM build
requirements: Under All Versions, select 1.7 FiveM Server Resource. The main download is the single-player version.
Start the audio resource and set audioNameHash in each target vehicle’s vehicles.meta to a sound ID from the release.

items.name: Mazda RX-7 13B Rotary Engine Sound
items.author: Aquaphobic
items.credits: Aquaphobic, with samples and REV guidance credited to Legacy_DMC in the release.
items.description: A rotary engine and exhaust sound for an individual vehicle.
items.requirementLabel: Server resource · Los Santos Tuners assets
requirements: Use a FiveM server build with Los Santos Tuners assets and follow the FiveM instructions in the release’s readme.txt.
Set the target vehicle’s audioNameHash to rotary7.

items.name: Server-Sided Sounds and Sirens
items.author: fk-1997
items.description: Stream siren sound banks to players and assign the tones through a compatible emergency vehicle resource.
requirements: Install the server resource and keep its manifest and audio banks together.
Configure a compatible controller such as Luxart Vehicle Control V3 with the sound-bank and tone IDs from the repository.
